compiled_state.description:
`scripts/` (41 files) is excluded from every static gate: `Makefile:11` sets `sources = src tests`,
so `make lint` never sees it, and `Makefile:205` runs `mypy src/rebar`, so `make typecheck` never
sees it either. `ruff check scripts/` today reports **78 violations**.

Blast radius is low — this workflow tooling is not shipped to clients — but seven of these files are
invoked directly by `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`, the blocking workflow behind the
`Verified` vote: `check_verify_gate_parity.py` (:130), `check_comment_hygiene.py` (:144),
`check_raw_git_writes.py` (:162), `check_wall_clock_asserts.py` (:176), `gen_env_registry.py` (:419),
`check_docs_index.py` (:441), `check_readme_quickstart.py` (:452). The gate implementations are
themselves ungated.

## The 28 substantive violations

| Rule | n | Nature |
|---|---|---|
| `RUF100` unused-noqa | 12 | Dead directives; `ruff --fix` removes them |
| `E501` line-too-long | 11 | Rewrap; no behavior |
| `RUF005` collection-concat | 2 | `prefix + [x]` -> `[*prefix, x]`; both in `check_complexity_baseline.py:181,187` |
| `RUF059` unused unpack | 2 | `jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:212,222` — `b1`/`b2` captured, never read |
| `B905` zip without `strict=` | 1 | `check_wall_clock_asserts.py:101` |

**No live defect is present in this set.** Two candidates were checked and cleared:

- `B905` at `check_wall_clock_asserts.py:101` is `zip(sub.ops, sub.comparators)` over an
  `ast.Compare`. Those lists are equal-length by construction (`a < b < c` yields `ops=[Lt,Lt]`,
  `comparators=[b,c]`), so the silent-truncation failure mode cannot occur. `strict=True` is correct
  as hardening, not a fix.
- The two `RUF059` sites capture an HTTP response body the probe deliberately does not inspect
  (read-back is a separate `_req` call). `_`-prefix them.

The `RUF100` count is itself the argument for the gate: 12 `noqa` directives are dead *because*
nothing lints the directory. Five reference rules not in `select` (`PLC0415`, `S603`, `S310`,
`PLR0915`) — confirm none documents a live intent before deleting.

## The 50 T201 (print) violations — exempt, do not fix

Print discipline in local workflow tooling is low value, and these scripts' prints are their output.
They sit in 10 files with no `per-file-ignores` entry: `calibrate_completion_floor.py` (11),
`check_verify_gate_parity.py` (7), `verify_mcp_publisher_pin.py` (6), `check_raw_git_writes.py` (6),
`t5c_calibrate.py` (5), `check_wall_clock_asserts.py` (5), `check_commit_message_wrap.py` (4),
`check_build_env_locked.py` (3), `check_dco_identity.py` (2), `normalize_ci_conclusion.py` (1).

**Resolve with ONE whole-directory entry `"scripts/**" = ["T201"]`, replacing the nine existing
single-file `scripts/*.py` entries** (`pyproject.toml:461,465,468,471,475,479,483,487,491`). This
takes `per-file-ignores` from 17 entries to 9 and converts the scripts exemption from nine
discretionary per-file entries into a single INVARIANT whole-directory one — the same shape as
`"tests/**"`, which the config already marks PERMANENT. It shrinks and hardens the allowlist rather
than growing it. Adding ten NEW single-file entries instead is explicitly rejected.

## Risk

Low. 25 of the 28 are provably zero-behavior. The remaining 3 need a reviewer who reads the
surrounding logic rather than the diff, and `check_complexity_baseline.py` is a gate whose own
correctness is being edited.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All 12 `RUF100`, 11 `E501`, 2 `RUF005`, 2 `RUF059` and 1 `B905` violations in `scripts/` are
      resolved
- [x] Any deleted `noqa` referencing a non-enabled rule is confirmed to document no live intent
- [x] The nine single-file `scripts/*.py` T201 entries are replaced by one `"scripts/**" = ["T201"]`;
      `per-file-ignores` has FEWER entries after this change than before
- [x] `scripts/` is added to the lint scope (`Makefile` `sources`) so `make lint` covers it, and CI
      is green on the result
- [x] The seven CI-invoked gate scripts behave identically: verified by a CI run, not inspection [operator-attested]
- [x] A follow-up ticket records the remaining `mypy` gap (`make typecheck` is `mypy src/rebar`;
      `scripts/` and `tests/` are untyped)

## CORRECTION (plan-review BLOCK, criteria G1G2/G6) — the formatter class was unbudgeted

The violation inventory above is built solely from `ruff check scripts/`. But adding `scripts`
to the Makefile `sources` variable also enrolls all 41 files in `ruff format --check $(sources)`
(`Makefile:153`, run by `make lint`) and `ruff format $(sources)` (`Makefile:149`).

Measured on the current tree: `ruff format --check scripts/` reports **7 files would be
reformatted, 37 already formatted**. That is a second, entirely separate failure class from the
78 `ruff check` findings, and `make lint` / CI would go red on it the moment `scripts` joins
`sources`.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [x] The 28 substantive `ruff check` violations are resolved (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2,
      RUF059 x2, B905 x1)
- [x] The 7 formatter-nonconforming scripts are reformatted, so `ruff format --check scripts/`
      is clean BEFORE `scripts` is added to `sources`
- [x] The 50 T201 (print) violations are exempted via a single consolidated `per-file-ignores`
      entry, not 10 per-file entries
- [x] `scripts/` is added to the Makefile `sources` variable and `make lint` is green
- [x] The five `RUF100` directives referencing rules not in `select` (`PLC0415`, `S603`, `S310`,
      `PLR0915`) are each confirmed not to document a live intent before deletion
- [x] No behaviour change to any script invoked by `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`


## CORRECTION 2 (plan-review BLOCK, criterion G6) — the consolidation creates NEW RUF100

Adding a single `"scripts/**" = ["T201"]` per-file-ignores entry makes every EXISTING inline
`# noqa: T201` directive in scripts/ redundant. RUF100 (unused-noqa) is enabled, so each redundant
directive becomes a NEW violation.

Measured on the current tree: **28 inline `# noqa: T201` directives across 13 files**. The
"RUF100 x12" figure in the inventory above was measured against the PRE-consolidation config and
does not include these.

This makes the work ORDER load-bearing. The two steps cannot be done independently:

1. Add the consolidated `"scripts/**" = ["T201"]` per-file-ignores entry, AND
2. Delete all 28 now-redundant inline `# noqa: T201` directives

in the SAME change, or `make lint` is red in between.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes both lists above)

- [x] The 28 substantive pre-existing `ruff check` violations are resolved (RUF100 x12, E501 x11,
      RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1)
- [x] The 7 formatter-nonconforming scripts are reformatted, so `ruff format --check scripts/` is
      clean BEFORE `scripts` joins `sources`
- [x] T201 is exempted via ONE consolidated `"scripts/**"` per-file-ignores entry, and in the SAME
      change all 28 inline `# noqa: T201` directives are deleted, so no new RUF100 is introduced
- [x] `scripts/` is added to the Makefile `sources` variable and `make lint` is green
- [x] The five `RUF100` directives referencing rules not in `select` (`PLC0415`, `S603`, `S310`,
      `PLR0915`) are each confirmed not to document a live intent before deletion
- [x] `ruff check scripts/` and `ruff format --check scripts/` are both clean at the end
- [x] No behaviour change to any script invoked by `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`
- [x] The post-sweep irreducible exception count is recorded on this ticket
